rows.label: Necraloid Rank 3, Odima
rows.note: 44,000 standing, 15 Animus Matrix, 350 Void Traces, 20 Father Tokens, Trumna Barrel Blueprint

conditions: Tiers unlock in order: clear Tier 1, then Tier 2, then Tier 3 once each.
Clearing Tier 3 once unlocks its Arcana bounty, which starts only from Mother in The Abscess, never the Necralisk, and never says "Arcana" anywhere.
Stage 1 of the Arcana bounty drops only the Blueprint; parts come from stages 2 onward.
Matrix turn-ins count toward the daily standing cap (16,000 + 500 per MR), so the Loid route takes four to five days at mid-20s MR.
Three wrong Requiem cipher attempts lock that vault's bonus door for good.
bonuses: Each of Tier 3's three Necramechs drops an Orokin Animus Matrix (5,000 standing); Orientation is 1,000 and Ballistics 2,500.
Nekros Desecrate, a Resource Booster and Resourceful Retriever raise Necramech matrix drops.
Octavia's Mallet plus Amp pops the hidden tumors in the stages; Mesa's Peacemaker can't hit them.

disclosures.title: drops first, Loid for the gaps
disclosures.body: A full Arcana run in the right rotation is roughly a 16-17% shot at that rotation's part, about 6 runs per part. Pull whatever the current rotation offers instead of waiting on one part, bank every matrix, and buy only what's still missing at Necraloid Rank 3. A plain Tier 3 vault rolls the same parts at 3.75% (Blueprint 6.25%).

disclosures.title: why solo
disclosures.body: Stage requirements scale with squad size faster than extra players help, and a late joiner can bump the requirement and cost the bonus. Pub squads that queued a normal vault often leave or kill the spawn pods the Arcana objective needs. Run the base vault in a pub if you like, then leave the party and take the Arcana bounty alone.

disclosures.title: stage tricks
disclosures.body: Emitter stage: its battery doesn't drain while it sits at the start. Leave your frame holding it, scout the crack in Operator, then transference back. Fluid sac stage: a companion that kills too fast (Verglas) ruins the few-throws bonus.

disclosures.title: drop table mismatch
disclosures.body: Overframe lists all three parts in rotation A at 6.43-7.14%; the wiki splits them A, B and C. The Update 29.5 notes also called them rotation A exclusive. The plan follows the wiki. Loid's shop prose says 8,000 for the Blueprint while his wares table says 6,000; budget 28,000 for the set.
